regime.summary: SBP hiked 25bp on 2019-01-31 to 10.25% and CPI is rising (7.2% vs 6.78% three months earlier), so the cycle is still tightening. The index has bounced 5.1% in a month but is down over 3, 6 and 12 months, and the rupee is weaker. Foreign corporates are buying while mutual funds sell. No method file gives a tradable edge in this setup, so I stay neutral and hold no book.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 10.25%; last MPC decision 2019-01-31: hike (+25bp)
